name: WH Heaven/Hell
source:
Detective infiltrates a school as a temporary instructor upon a request to investigate dark rumors about the school. In order to explore the truth of rumors detective needs to select reliable partners and persuade them to cooperate.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-june-2001-no-reality.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名侦探受托调查学校里的黑暗传闻，于是以临时教师的身份潜入学校。为了查明传闻背后的真相，他需要选出值得信赖的伙伴，并说服他们协助调查。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-june-2001-no-reality.html]vndbreview[/url]]
